input.rationale: Section 4 deals only with the term, notice of termination and the Termination Payment; nothing in the Agreement addresses exit. Section 8 (Confidentiality) imposes non-disclosure obligations on HDI but no return or destruction duty, and Section 10.7 (Survival) is silent on exit. In a hosting arrangement where HDI holds our Content, user information and customer data, the total absence of a data-return or transition mechanic falls below even the fallback. We insert a new Section 4.3 at the preferred position: up to 6 months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of Company data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiration or termination, then deletion with written certification.

ops.text: 4.3 Transition Assistance; Return of Company Data. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to 6 months at HDI's then-current rates; (b) return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data and other Company data in HDI's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after such expiration or termination; and (c) thereafter delete such Content, information and data from its systems and certify such deletion to the Company in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no exit mechanic, so we are adding Section 4.3: up to 6 months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiration or termination, and deletion with written certification thereafter. This is our preferred transition position; we can discuss a 90-day assistance period, but need the 30-day return.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion clause in Section 4

Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format.
